scope: 2020 calibration exploration; eight component ablations and two residual-IV hybrids
pricing_sample: Exactly the 1068 fitted snapshots and 118117 withheld contracts from the original strategy lab
pricing_selection: Keep reference IV interpolation unless a hybrid lowers common-quote MAE by at least 5%, also lowers equally weighted snapshot MAE, and has no higher rate of failing the same within-expiry strike-grid checks. These checks are necessary, not sufficient, for absence of arbitrage.
strategy_replay: Original rules, buffers, costs, fixed contract identities and next-close execution; replay all available daily strategies separately with calendar structural, physical-clock hybrid, calendar-clock hybrid and reference interpolation marks. Structural sensitivities remain the calendar hedge-sizing proxy.
qualification: A strategy can qualify only with at least 50 resolved trades, no unresolved positions, positive mean net at quoted spreads, positive lower endpoint of the calendar-week cluster bootstrap 95% interval, and positive mean after removing any one name. No threshold search.
maker_gate: Midpoint profitability or a spread-cost counterfactual cannot validate a maker strategy. Require timestamped option NBBO and trades, quote sizes and conditions, synchronized underlying, executable fees, latency and queue assumptions, partial fills, legging and inventory limits, and post-fill markouts before claiming fill-adjusted profit.
future_status: Reserved prospective paper evaluation only. Outcomes are unavailable at freeze time. No orders or scheduled jobs.
future_inputs: Parameters fitted only to contemporaneously available reference quotes; historical clock features strictly before signal; earnings calendars must be point-in-time known; same-strike put/call twins remain withheld. Exclude names while dividends or corporate actions violate the pricing assumptions. Insufficient eligible observations means inconclusive, not rule changes.
future_primary: Held-strike MAE versus reference-only interpolation, equally weighted by snapshot; any qualified strategy separately judged on net P&L with unresolved outcomes disclosed. No new strategy qualifies by looking at the reserved outcomes.
limitations: Six selected names, one crisis calibration year, retrospective earnings dates, European approximation, no financing/borrow/margin/assignment model; quoted executions are scenarios, not verified fills. A candidate passing the statistical gate still requires these data and execution gaps to be resolved before deployment.
